headline: Your TruGolf waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing indoor golf businesses into the right TruGolf commercial offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for David Harper, Global Head of Sales.
productSummary: TruGolf (trugolf.com) designs indoor golf simulators, launch monitors, and the E6 simulation software that runs them. Homepage: 15k+ 4K courses, 25 data parameters, 4K display resolution, 1B+ shots tracked. Lineup with published starting prices: LaunchBox from $2,999 (portable camera-based launch monitor, indoor or on a range mat, no marked clubs or specialty balls, sold with E6 CONNECT Home including 30 owned courses and no annual subscription on that bundle); APOGEE from $7,995 (ceiling-mounted launch monitor, 15,000+ courses and 25 professional-grade data metrics); MultiSport ARCADE from $4,500 (ceiling-mounted, works independently of the launch monitor; baseball, hockey, soccer, bowling, disc golf and more); Starter 10 at $6,995; E6 (2026) at $450. Commercial systems are custom-quoted around APOGEE plus the E6 CONNECT Commercial Suite (Clubhouse Dashboard, league software, member messaging, simulator security, CSV usage reports). About page: pushing simulator golf since 1982, first company to develop the 3D simulator engine; in 1999 Access Software was purchased by Microsoft and TruGolf kept the Links programming and graphics team. Commercial FAQ: exclusive technology supplier for Golf Everywhere in Flower Mound, Texas (largest indoor golf facility in the United States) with a $4.5 million contract on that page; powers the TruGolf Links franchise network; trusted by thousands of indoor golf facilities worldwide. RANGE by TruGolf is described on the simulators page as the first digital range in the world, 7 players practicing simultaneously. E6 pairs with 18+ / 19 launch monitors (Garmin, Rapsodo, FlightScope and others named on software pages) so software can attach without a hardware rip-out. Commercial sales: 1-866-711-4653. Homeowners stay out of this waterfall.
coreInsight: David already sells commercial simulator businesses a partner, not a gadget: APOGEE in the ceiling, E6 CONNECT Commercial Suite on the desk, MultiSport when the room has to work for non-golfers. The one TAM is indoor golf businesses Google Maps already lists as indoor golf, golf entertainment, teaching academies, clubhouses, hotels, and bars with a sim. The one routing signal is the facility class that same Maps-plus-site scrape already prints (multi-bay center, academy, new opening, or remaining in-TAM), because bay language, lesson copy, and a coming-soon page tell you whether they need Clubhouse ops across bays, coaching data in one bay, a first commercial build, or the course-library and MultiSport offer. Published home prices are merge-tag proof, not the commercial quote. Do not invent a bay-rental or membership number TruGolf did not publish.

heroStats.label: 4K courses, on their homepage and commercial FAQ (industry's most extensive course library, their words)

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is the facility class Maps and the site already print
sections.takeaway: Google Maps already names the indoor golf business. The same pull plus the homepage usually prints how many bays they run, whether they sell lessons, or whether they are still coming soon. That class is stronger than a headcount guess, and it is free to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every indoor golf business
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Multi-bay centers go first, then teaching academies, then new openings, then every remaining in-TAM club, hotel, bar, and single-bay room. Homeowners never enter the list.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each facility class gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Multi-bay centers get a Clubhouse Dashboard ops brief. Academies get a 25-metric coaching brief. New openings get a commercial build map. The rest get the 15,000+ course and MultiSport one-pager.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Fill the bays, coach the data, open the room, keep them playing
sections.takeaway: The list is always Maps indoor golf businesses, aimed at owners, GMs, directors of instruction, and club managers. City and competitor name are merge tags, not a second TAM. A/Bs sit on the exclusive routes.

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the room they already advertise
sections.takeaway: Notice the bay count, the academy, or the coming-soon page, poke the ops or coaching gap that class implies, then ask for a one-letter yes. Quote only prices and counts TruGolf already publishes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the multi-bay center first
sections.takeaway: Start where they already run several bays and still schedule them by clipboard. Prove reply density, then roll academy, new opening, and the course-library catch-all.

signalReasons: Google Maps categories for indoor golf, golf simulator, golf entertainment, golf academy, country club, hotel golf, and sports bar with a sim are the commercial TAM TruGolf's For My Business and commercial pages already sell into, in one pull. Homeowners and garage builds stay out.

The same pull plus the company website usually returns bay_count (photos, booking pages, '6-bay' copy), academy language (lessons, PGA, fitting), or a coming-soon / grand-opening page. That is enough to assign facility_class without a paid enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live TruGolf copy: Clubhouse Dashboard and E6 CONNECT Commercial Suite for multi-bay ops, 25 data parameters plus Coaching on Demand / Joe Hallett for academies, custom commercial builds and the Golf Everywhere exclusive-supplier line for new rooms, and 15,000+ courses plus MultiSport ARCADE for everyone else.

City, named competitor, and title are scrape filters and merge tags. They are not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last, never the TAM spine. Do not route on a guessed utilization percentage. TruGolf did not publish one.

sources.name: Google Maps Places
sources.delivers: Indoor golf, golf simulator, golf entertainment, golf academy, country club, hotel, and bar/restaurant operators with a visible sim. The TAM gate and the spine of every route. One pull.

sources.name: Company website / booking page scrape
sources.delivers: bay_count, facility_class, lesson/academy language, coming-soon or grand-opening copy, and any named launch monitor or software (Uneekor, TrackMan, Full Swing, Golfzon, GSPro, Awesome Golf). The integer and class used to assign Tier 1 / 2 / 3 / catch-all.

sources.name: Google reviews and photo text
sources.delivers: Backup bay_count when the homepage is silent ('booked the back bay', 'six simulators') and a human-readable named_site for the first line.

sources.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator (after routing)
sources.delivers: Owner, GM, Director of Instruction, Head Professional, Club Manager, Director of Golf after the domain is routed. Title is a merge tag, not a second TAM.

sources.name: Apollo (after qualification)
sources.delivers: Work emails for already-routed accounts. Do not buy a raw 'golf' list and hope.

sources.name: Optional TruGolf customer / Links franchise suppress
sources.delivers: already_customer exclusion when David can supply current commercial installs and TruGolf Links locations. Named testimonials on trugolf.com (Fore Seasons, Wisconsin Indoor Golf Center, Golf Everywhere) are not a blanket exclude of every other room.

routingRules.why: Already a customer. Named testimonials and the Golf Everywhere install are not enough to exclude every other location.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND NOT already_customer AND facility_class = multi_bay_center (bay_count >= 3 OR Maps/site language is indoor golf center, golf lounge, or golf entertainment with multiple bays)
routingRules.why: They already run several bays. TruGolf's commercial FAQ says the Clubhouse Dashboard tracks shot data, player sessions, and usage across every simulator, with CSV reports, league scoring, and remote bay lock. APOGEE is the recommended high-traffic hardware because it is ceiling-mounted, has no components in the hitting zone, and tracks right- and left-handed shots without specialty balls or marked clubs. Bay-count cutoff is GTMx routing, not a TruGolf site field.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND NOT already_customer AND NOT Tier 1 AND facility_class = academy (site or Maps names lessons, academy, fitting, PGA instruction, or director of instruction)
routingRules.why: The job is improvement, not bay rental. Homepage: 25 data parameters. Simulators page: Bag Mapping, Club Fitting, Scoring Zone, 46 Skills Challenges, and PGA Coach of the Year Joe Hallett embedded in Coaching on Demand. Class is estimated GTMx taxonomy, not a TruGolf site field.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND NOT already_customer AND NOT Tier 1 AND NOT Tier 2 AND facility_class = new_opening (coming soon, grand opening, now open, or hiring simulator staff / bay attendants)
routingRules.why: The room is being specified now. Commercial page: custom builds, software and hardware, 'fill more bays.' FAQ: exclusive technology supplier for Golf Everywhere in Flower Mound, Texas, $4.5 million contract on that page; commercial pricing is custom-quoted by bay count, enclosure, 4K, APOGEE ceiling-mount, and E6 CONNECT Commercial Suite. Contact 1-866-711-4653. Class estimated.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND NOT already_customer AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Remaining clubs, hotels, bars, offices, and single-bay rooms still in the commercial TAM. Homepage: 15k+ 4K courses and MultiSport ARCADE from $4,500. Commercial FAQ: bars and restaurants, hotels and resorts, corporate offices, entertainment venues. Mandatory 100% TAM coverage. Homeowners stay out.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Multi-bay indoor golf center
tiers.trigger: Maps or the site shows 3+ bays, or the Place is an indoor golf center / golf lounge / golf entertainment venue with multiple simulators. Bay-count cutoff is GTMx routing, not a TruGolf published band.
tiers.pain: They already sell time on several bays. Scheduling, leagues, and who is actually playing still live in a clipboard or a generic booking tool, so they cannot see which bay is idle, lock a bay remotely, or run a league without walking the floor.
tiers.valueProp: E6 CONNECT Commercial Suite plus Clubhouse Dashboard: centralized shot data, player sessions, and usage metrics across every simulator, CSV usage reports, league season creation and handicaps, member messaging, and simulator security that locks systems remotely by bay. Commercial FAQ: APOGEE is the recommended high-traffic foundation (ceiling-mounted, nothing in the hitting zone, right- and left-handed, no specialty balls or marked clubs). Fore Seasons testimonial on the simulators page: 5 TruGolf commercial simulators, accuracy, built to last, support that prevents downtime.
tiers.dataSource: Google Maps plus website / booking-page bay language
tiers.replyDensity: Highest. They already run the multi-bay job the Commercial Suite is built for.

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Teaching academy or fitting studio
tiers.trigger: Not Tier 1, and the site or Maps names lessons, academy, club fitting, PGA instruction, or a director of instruction. Class estimated.
tiers.pain: The room is a teaching product. Range data and on-course feel still disagree, so the lesson ends in a notebook instead of a bag map the student can replay.
tiers.valueProp: Homepage: 25 data parameters. Simulators page: APOGEE shot-by-shot data plus E6 improvement suite (Bag Mapping, Club Fitting, Scoring Zone, 46 Skills Challenges) and Coaching on Demand with PGA Coach of the Year Joe Hallett. E6 software pages: compatible with 18+ / 19 launch monitors, so an academy already on Garmin, Rapsodo, or FlightScope can attach software before they rip out hardware.
tiers.dataSource: Maps category plus site lesson / academy copy
tiers.replyDensity: High. They already sell instruction. The data suite is the offer.

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: New indoor opening
tiers.trigger: Not Tier 1 or 2, and a coming-soon page, grand opening, now-open copy, or a job post for simulator staff / bay attendants. Class estimated.
tiers.pain: The room is being specified now. The default is to copy whatever the last entertainment venue bought, then discover leagues, security, and course library after the enclosure is already up.
tiers.valueProp: Commercial page: software, hardware, and custom build-outs to fill more bays and keep customers coming back. FAQ: exclusive technology supplier for Golf Everywhere in Flower Mound, Texas, the largest indoor golf facility in the United States, $4.5 million contract cited on that page; TruGolf Links franchise network; custom quote by bay count, enclosure, 4K, APOGEE, and E6 CONNECT Commercial Suite. RANGE by TruGolf on the simulators page: 7 players practicing simultaneously. Commercial line: 1-866-711-4653.
tiers.dataSource: Coming-soon / careers pages plus Maps new-place signals
tiers.replyDensity: Medium. Timing is real. The quote is still custom. Do not invent a package price.

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Every remaining in-TAM indoor golf business
tiers.trigger: Any remaining clubhouse, hotel, resort, bar, restaurant, office, or single-bay room Google Maps already lists as in-TAM, with no multi-bay, academy, or new-opening match. Homeowners stay out.
tiers.pain: No multi-bay ops problem and no lesson product. The room still has to keep mixed groups playing, including people who did not come to golf.
tiers.valueProp: Homepage: 15k+ 4K courses, MultiSport ARCADE from $4,500. Commercial FAQ: MultiSport expands the customer base beyond golfers with baseball, hockey, soccer, bowling, and more; bars and restaurants, hotels and resorts, corporate offices, and entertainment venues are named use cases. LaunchBox from $2,999 when the room needs portable, not ceiling-mount. Do not quote a commercial bay price. That is custom.
tiers.dataSource: Remaining Maps TAM after higher tiers route out
tiers.replyDensity: Lowest. Broadest list, softest CTA, highest volume. Still 100% of TAM.

campaigns.name: Clubhouse Ops Brief
campaigns.strategy: Open by naming {{bay_count}} bays at {{company_name}}, poke clipboard scheduling and no remote bay lock, then offer the Clubhouse Ops Brief: Clubhouse Dashboard, leagues, CSV usage, simulator security. APOGEE as the high-traffic ceiling-mount.
campaigns.overview: Highest intent route. Quote only the bay count the site or reviews actually show. Never invent utilization or membership revenue.

campaigns.name: Golf Everywhere scale variant
campaigns.filter: Same Tier 1 list, scale copy instead of ops copy
campaigns.strategy: Keep {{bay_count}} in the notice line. Swap the poke to Golf Everywhere in Flower Mound as exclusive technology supplier and the $4.5 million contract on TruGolf's commercial FAQ. Same magnet.
campaigns.overview: A/B against the ops brief. Same exclusive route. Do not imply {{company_name}} is that size.

campaigns.name: 25-Metric Coaching Brief
campaigns.strategy: Name the academy or lesson product, poke notebook-vs-replay, then offer 25 data parameters, Bag Mapping, Club Fitting, 46 Skills Challenges, and Joe Hallett Coaching on Demand.
campaigns.overview: Second exclusive route. If {{named_competitor}} is on the site, it is a merge tag for E6 compatibility, not a tear-down of that brand.

campaigns.name: Commercial Build Map
campaigns.strategy: Name the coming-soon or hiring signal, poke specifying the room before leagues and security exist, then offer the custom-build map and the Golf Everywhere exclusive-supplier line. No invented package price.
campaigns.overview: Third exclusive route. Financing exists (commercial FAQ) but terms are not published. Do not invent a lease number.

campaigns.name: Course Library + MultiSport One-Pager
campaigns.filter: Remaining in-TAM indoor golf businesses, no Tier 1-3 class
campaigns.strategy: Billboard 15,000+ 4K courses and MultiSport ARCADE from $4,500 for mixed groups. Soft offer is the one-pager. Homeowners stay out.
campaigns.overview: Mandatory catch-all for 100% TAM coverage. Softest CTA in the cascade.

campaigns.name: Catch-all A/B: portable LaunchBox
campaigns.filter: Same catch-all filter, alternate Day 0 copy only
campaigns.strategy: Variant that leads with LaunchBox from $2,999, 30 owned courses, no annual subscription on that bundle, indoor or on a range mat. Same magnet. Do not present $2,999 as a commercial multi-bay quote.
campaigns.overview: Only two variants at a time on the catch-all. Vary the opener, hold the offer and CTA constant.

launchPlan: Confirm in_tam: indoor golf businesses Google Maps already lists (indoor golf, golf simulator, golf entertainment, golf academy, country club clubhouse with a sim, hotel/resort sim, bar/restaurant with a sim). Homeowners, garage builds, and consumer launch-monitor shoppers stay out entirely.

Scrape Maps plus the company site for bay_count, academy language, coming-soon / hiring copy, and any named competitor. Classify facility_class as multi_bay_center, academy, new_opening, or none. First match wins. Bay-count >= 3 is GTMx routing, not a TruGolf published band.

Apply a TruGolf customer and TruGolf Links suppress list before anything sends if David can supply one. Named testimonials (Fore Seasons, Wisconsin Indoor Golf Center, Golf Everywhere) are not a franchise-wide exclude.
Resolve Owner, GM, Director of Instruction, Head Professional, Club Manager, Director of Golf in Sales Nav or Apollo only after the domain is routed. Title and city are merge tags.

Launch Tier 1 Clubhouse Ops Brief first. Smallest list, sharpest multi-bay signal, closest to the Commercial Suite. Ops copy as the control, Golf Everywhere $4.5M line as the A/B on the same list. Do not put an estimated tier count in an email.
Add Tier 2 academy once {{named_competitor}} merge tags are clean, then Tier 3 new openings, then the course-library catch-all last.

Do not launch a tier under about 1,500 contacts. That threshold is the waterfall SOP, not a TruGolf site number. Do not invent occupancy, membership, or bay-rental figures. The only prices that may appear in copy are the ones on trugolf.com: LaunchBox from $2,999, APOGEE from $7,995, MultiSport ARCADE from $4,500, Starter 10 $6,995, E6 (2026) $450, and the $4.5 million Golf Everywhere contract on the commercial FAQ. Commercial multi-bay installs stay 'custom-quoted'.

thresholds.action: Scale that tier. Keep the winning ops, coaching, build, or library variant.
Good. Let it run. Do not mix homeowners into this waterfall, and do not move the spine onto a raw Apollo golf list.
Borderline. Swap only the magnet or the first-line facility class. Do not change the route.

thresholds.rate: Worse than 1 per 500, or reply rate under 1% after 1,500+ sends
thresholds.action: Cut that copy variant. Keep the exclusive waterfall. Retune the estimated multi_bay_center / academy / new_opening synonym lists from the live scrape if a band is starved of contacts.
